legend: Thomas has decided today is the day that Crapper & Co. bands together and embarks on an odyssey! That is, an odyssey aboard rolling chairs across the office...

However, due to a variety of logistical reasons, the odyssey is not one big path taken by all the employees at once. Rather, it is split up into p$$$p$$$ journeys across the office, which the employees can choose to take in any order.

The office consists of n$$$n$$$ buildings, connected together by n−1$$$n-1$$$ hallways. Journey i$$$i$$$ specifies its start building si$$$s_i$$$ and its end building ei$$$e_i$$$, and employees are expected to take the shortest path from si$$$s_i$$$ to ei$$$e_i$$$ via chair.

Given that rolling chairs not exactly the easiest to maneuver in, HR is concerned about how safe this activity will be. After all, any two journeys that use the same hallway or office building could result in a collision! Can you figure out how many pairs of journeys could lead to a collision?
input: The first line contains 2 integers, n$$$n$$$ and m$$$m$$$ (1≤n,m≤2⋅105$$$1 \leq n, m \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$), representing the number of buildings and journeys, respectively.
Then, n−1$$$n-1$$$ lines follow, each containing two integers, a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$ (1≤a,b≤n$$$1 \leq a,b \leq n$$$), denoting a hallway connecting offices a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$.
Finally, m$$$m$$$ lines follow, the i$$$i$$$th of which contains si$$$s_i$$$ and ei$$$e_i$$$ (1≤si,ei≤n$$$1 \leq s_i, e_i \leq n$$$), denoting the start and end points of a journey.
output: Output a single integer, the number of intersecting journeys.

legend.ai: 托马斯决定，今天就是 Crapper & Co. 集结起来踏上远征的日子！也就是说，这是一场乘坐滚轮椅穿越办公室的远征……
然而，由于各种后勤方面的原因，这次远征并不是所有员工同时走完的一条大路径。相反，它被分成 p$$$p$$$ 段穿越办公室的旅程，员工可以选择以任意顺序完成这些旅程。
办公室由 n$$$n$$$ 栋楼组成，这些楼之间由 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 条走廊相互连接。第 i$$$i$$$ 次行程规定了其起始楼 si$$$s_i$$$ 和终点楼 ei$$$e_i$$$，员工需要乘坐椅子从 si$$$s_i$$$ 到 ei$$$e_i$$$，并沿最短路径行进。
考虑到带轮椅子并不是那么容易操控，人力资源部门担心这项活动的安全性。毕竟，任何两次经过同一条走廊或办公楼的行程都可能导致碰撞！你能算出可能发生碰撞的行程对数吗？

input.ai: 第一行包含 2 个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 m$$$m$$$(1≤n,m≤2⋅105$$$1 \leq n, m \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)，分别表示楼栋数和行程数。
接下来 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 行，每行包含两个整数 a$$$a$$$ 和 b$$$b$$$(1≤a,b≤n$$$1 \leq a,b \leq n$$$)，表示一条连接办公楼 a$$$a$$$ 和 b$$$b$$$ 的走廊。
最后接下来 m$$$m$$$ 行，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含 si$$$s_i$$$ 和 ei$$$e_i$$$(1≤si,ei≤n$$$1 \leq s_i, e_i \leq n$$$)，表示一次行程的起点和终点。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示相交行程的数量。
